support_claim: CRM record OAK-77 carries the old English-facing name for the company that rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH without changing legal identifier HRB 88421, which registry and billing both attach to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.

steps.fact: The left referent crm:OAK-77 corresponds to CRM row OAK-77 with account name Oakfield Logistics.
Commercial notes state that Oakfield rebranded from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH and that Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
Commercial notes state that CRM still shows the old English-facing name for this company.

The selected CRM observation for left referent crm:OAK-77 is row OAK-77 with name Oakfield Logistics, which is the old English-facing CRM name described in the notes for the entity that rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Company registry row HRB 88421 lists the legal entity as Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Because HRB 88421 did not change across the rebrand, Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same legal entity identified by HRB 88421.
crm:OAK-77 (CRM record showing the old English-facing name) and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH (current legal and billing name tied to unchanged HRB 88421) denote the same legal counterparty.
